ko.title: 58% 급등 및 지속 상승: 이번 가을 수백만 명에게 닥친 ACA 보험료 충격의 실상

segments.src: ## A Sharp Jump in What Families Actually Pay
segments.tr: ## 가계가 실제로 납부하는 금액의 급격한 상승

segments.src: Millions of Americans who buy health insurance through the Affordable Care Act marketplaces are opening their fall renewal notices to a jarring number.
segments.tr: 의료보험개혁법(ACA) 마켓플레이스를 통해 건강보험을 구매하는 수백만 명의 미국인들이 가을 갱신 통지서에서 충격적인 숫자를 마주하고 있습니다.

segments.src: According to research from health policy analysts, the average monthly premium that marketplace enrollees pay after tax credits are applied has climbed from about $113 to roughly $178 — an increase of nearly 58%.
segments.tr: 보건 정책 분석가들의 연구에 따르면, 세액 공제가 적용된 후 마켓플레이스 가입자가 지불하는 평균 월 보험료는 약 $113에서 대략 $178로 올랐으며, 이는 거의 58% 증가한 수치입니다.

segments.src: For a household budget, that is not a rounding error.
segments.tr: 가계 예산에서 이 정도 금액은 단지 끝자리를 맞추는 수준의 오차가 아닙니다.

segments.src: It is the difference between an affordable monthly bill and a genuine financial strain.
segments.tr: 그것은 감당할 수 있는 월별 고지서와 실질적인 재정적 부담 사이의 차이입니다.

segments.src: The timing lines up with open enrollment season, which typically runs from November through mid-January in most states.
segments.tr: 이 시기는 대개 대부분의 주에서 11월부터 1월 중순까지 진행되는 공개 가입(open enrollment) 시즌과 맞물려 있습니다.

segments.src: That means the sticker shock is landing right as households are being asked to actively choose or renew a plan for the coming year.
segments.tr: 이는 가계가 다가오는 해의 플랜을 적극적으로 선택하거나 갱신해야 하는 바로 그 시점에 가격 충격이 닥치고 있음을 의미합니다.

segments.src: ## Why the Cost of Coverage Is Rising
segments.tr: ## 보장 비용이 상승하는 이유

segments.src: The core driver behind this increase is the scheduled expiration of enhanced federal subsidies that were first introduced during the pandemic and later extended.
segments.tr: 이러한 인상의 핵심 동인은 팬데믹 기간 동안 처음 도입된 후 연장되었던 강화된 연방 보조금의 예정된 만료입니다.

segments.src: Those enhanced tax credits reduced out-of-pocket premium costs for a broad range of income levels, including many middle-income households that previously received little or no assistance.
segments.tr: 이러한 강화된 세액 공제는 이전에 지원을 거의 또는 전혀 받지 못했던 많은 중산층 가구를 포함하여 광범위한 소득 수준에 대해 본인 부담 보험료 비용을 낮춰주었습니다.

segments.src: As those enhancements lapse, the subsidy amount shrinks, and the gap that enrollees must cover out of pocket grows — even if the sticker price of the underlying plan hasn't changed dramatically.
segments.tr: 이러한 혜택이 소멸함에 따라 보조금 금액은 줄어들고, 가입자가 본인 부담으로 메워야 하는 격차는 커집니다. 비록 기본 플랜의 표시 가격 자체가 크게 변하지 않았더라도 말입니다.

segments.src: On top of that, insurers in many states have also filed for higher base rates for next year, citing rising medical costs, hospital and prescription drug prices, and higher utilization of care.
segments.tr: 게다가 많은 주의 보험사들은 의료 비용 상승, 병원 및 처방약 가격 인상, 의료 이용률 증가를 이유로 내년도 기본 요율 인상을 신청했습니다.

segments.src: When a smaller subsidy meets a higher list price, the combined effect on what a family actually pays can be substantial.
segments.tr: 줄어든 보조금과 높아진 표시 가격이 만나면, 가계가 실제로 지불하는 금액에 미치는 복합적인 영향은 상당할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## Who Is Most Exposed
segments.tr: ## 가장 취약한 대상은 누구인가

segments.src: Health policy researchers estimate that as many as 4 million people could lose marketplace coverage in the coming year if enrollment trends continue on their current path.
segments.tr: 보건 정책 연구원들은 가입 추세가 현재 경로를 유지할 경우 다가오는 해에 최대 400만 명이 마켓플레이스 보장을 잃을 수 있다고 추정합니다.

segments.src: Early sign-up data already shows softening enrollment compared to the same point in prior years, which analysts attribute to affordability concerns and confusion around new subsidy amounts.
segments.tr: 초기 가입 데이터는 이미 이전 연도의 동일한 시점과 비교해 가입세가 약화되고 있음을 보여주며, 분석가들은 이를 감당 가능성 우려와 새로운 보조금 금액에 대한 혼란 때문으로 보고 있습니다.

segments.src: The households most exposed tend to be:
segments.tr: 가장 취약한 가구는 대개 다음과 같습니다.

segments.src: - **Self-employed workers and small-business owners** who rely on the individual market because they don't have access to employer coverage.
segments.tr: - **자영업자 및 소기업 소유주**: 고용주 보장을 받을 수 없어 개인 시장에 의존하는 사람들입니다.

segments.src: - **Early retirees** not yet eligible for Medicare who buy marketplace plans to bridge the gap.
segments.tr: - **조기 퇴직자**: 아직 메디케어(Medicare) 혜택을 받을 자격이 되지 않아 그 공백을 메우기 위해 마켓플레이스 플랜을 구매하는 사람들입니다.

segments.src: - **Gig workers and freelancers** whose income can hover near the thresholds where subsidy eligibility changes sharply.
segments.tr: - **긱 워커(임시직 노동자) 및 프리랜서**: 소득이 보조금 자격 요건이 급격히 변하는 기준선 근처에 걸쳐 있는 사람들입니다.

segments.src: - **Middle-income families** who benefited from the temporary subsidy expansion but may fall outside more limited assistance going forward.
segments.tr: - **중산층 가구**: 일시적인 보조금 확대 혜택을 받았으나 향후 더 제한적인 지원 대상에서 제외될 수 있는 사람들입니다.

segments.src: ## What Experts Are Watching
segments.tr: ## 전문가들이 주목하는 부분

segments.src: Nonpartisan researchers, insurance regulators, and consumer advocacy groups are watching two things closely this fall: whether Congress takes any action on subsidy levels before enrollment locks in for next year, and how state insurance marketplaces communicate the changes to enrollees.
segments.tr: 초당파 연구원, 보험 규제 기관, 소비자 옹호 단체들은 이번 가을 두 가지 사항을 면밀히 주시하고 있습니다. 바로 내년도 가입이 확정되기 전에 의회가 보조금 수준에 대해 조치를 취할지 여부와, 주 정부가 운영하는 보험 마켓플레이스가 가입자들에게 이러한 변화를 어떻게 전달할지입니다.

segments.src: Several state-run exchanges have said they are ramping up outreach and reminding consumers to actively shop around rather than letting a plan auto-renew, since switching to a different plan or metal tier can sometimes offset part of the increase.
segments.tr: 여러 주 정부 운영 거래소는 홍보를 강화하고 있으며, 플랜이 자동 갱신되도록 두기보다는 소비자가 적극적으로 비교 쇼핑을 하도록 상기시키고 있다고 밝혔습니다. 다른 플랜이나 메탈 등급(metal tier)으로 전환하면 인상분의 일부를 상쇄할 수 있는 경우가 있기 때문입니다.

segments.src: Consumer advocates also note that subsidy eligibility and amounts vary significantly by income, age, family size, and state, so national averages don't tell the whole story for any individual household.
segments.tr: 소비자 옹호론자들은 또한 보조금 자격과 금액이 소득, 연령, 가족 규모, 주에 따라 크게 다르기 때문에 전국 평균이 개별 가구의 상황을 온전히 대변하지는 못한다고 지적합니다.

segments.src: A modest premium increase for one family could be a much larger jump for another, depending on exactly where their income falls relative to subsidy cutoffs.
segments.tr: 한 가구에게는 완만한 보험료 인상이 다른 가구에게는 훨씬 더 큰 폭의 상승이 될 수 있으며, 이는 보조금 차단 기준선 대비 소득이 정확히 어디에 위치하는지에 따라 달라집니다.

segments.src: ## What Enrollees Can Do Right Now
segments.tr: ## 가입자가 지금 당장 할 수 있는 일

segments.src: Financial counselors and healthcare navigators generally recommend a few concrete steps as open enrollment approaches:
segments.tr: 재무 상담사와 헬스케어 네비게이터들은 일반적으로 공개 가입 기간이 다가옴에 따라 몇 가지 구체적인 조치를 권장합니다.

segments.src: 1. **Don't let your plan auto-renew without checking.** Log back into the marketplace and re-verify income and household information, since outdated estimates can affect your subsidy amount.
segments.tr: 1. **확인 없이 플랜이 자동 갱신되도록 두지 마십시오.** 마켓플레이스에 다시 로그인하여 소득 및 가구 정보를 재확인하십시오. 오래된 추정치는 보조금 금액에 영향을 미칠 수 있습니다.

segments.src: 2. **Compare plans across metal tiers.** A lower-premium bronze or silver plan with a higher deductible may make more financial sense for some households than staying on last year's plan.
segments.tr: 2. **메탈 등급별로 플랜을 비교하십시오.** 공제액(deductible)은 높지만 보험료가 낮은 브론즈 또는 실버 플랜이 일부 가구에는 작년 플랜을 유지하는 것보다 재정적으로 더 합리적일 수 있습니다.

segments.src: 3. **Ask about free local help.** Certified enrollment assisters and navigators, often available through community health centers or state marketplaces, can help estimate real costs at no charge.
segments.tr: 3. **무료 지역 지원에 대해 문의하십시오.** 지역 보건 센터나 주 마켓플레이스를 통해 종종 이용할 수 있는 공인 가입 도우미 및 네비게이터는 무료로 실제 비용을 추정하는 데 도움을 줄 수 있습니다.

segments.src: 4. **Check state-based programs.** Some states have supplemental subsidy programs on top of federal tax credits, which can meaningfully soften the increase.
segments.tr: 4. **주 정부 기반 프로그램을 확인하십시오.** 일부 주에는 연방 세액 공제 외에도 추가 보조금 프로그램이 있어 인상 폭을 의미 있게 완화할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## The Bigger Picture
segments.tr: ## 더 큰 그림

segments.src: This year's premium jump is a reminder of how sensitive household healthcare costs are to federal policy decisions that can shift from one year to the next.
segments.tr: 올해의 보험료 급등은 가계의 의료 비용이 해마다 바뀔 수 있는 연방 정책 결정에 얼마나 민감한지 상기시켜 줍니다.

segments.src: Whether or not lawmakers revisit the subsidy structure, the immediate reality for many families is that the cost of maintaining coverage is going up, and open enrollment is the narrow window in which they can act to manage that increase.
segments.tr: 입법자들이 보조금 구조를 재검토하든 그렇지 않든, 많은 가정이 직면한 즉각적인 현실은 보장을 유지하는 비용이 오르고 있다는 점이며, 공개 가입 기간은 이러한 인상에 대처하기 위해 행동할 수 있는 좁은 창구라는 것입니다.

segments.src: Financial advisors generally encourage anyone affected to review their options early rather than waiting until the final days of the enrollment period, when plan comparisons and assistance appointments become harder to schedule.
segments.tr: 재무 설계사들은 일반적으로 영향을 받는 모든 이들에게 플랜 비교 및 지원 예약이 더 어려워지는 가입 기간의 마지막 날까지 기다리기보다 조기에 옵션을 검토할 것을 권장합니다.

zh.title: 上涨58%且仍在攀升：深入了解今年秋季影响数百万人的《平价医疗法案》(ACA)保费冲击

segments.src: ## A Sharp Jump in What Families Actually Pay
segments.tr: ## 家庭实际支出的大幅跳升

segments.src: Millions of Americans who buy health insurance through the Affordable Care Act marketplaces are opening their fall renewal notices to a jarring number.
segments.tr: 数百万通过《平价医疗法案》(Affordable Care Act) 市场购买健康保险的美国人，在收到秋季续保通知时，看到了一个令人震惊的数字。

segments.src: According to research from health policy analysts, the average monthly premium that marketplace enrollees pay after tax credits are applied has climbed from about $113 to roughly $178 — an increase of nearly 58%.
segments.tr: 根据卫生政策分析师的研究，在扣除税收抵免后，市场参保人支付的平均月保费已从约 $113 攀升至约 $178 —— 涨幅近 58%。

segments.src: For a household budget, that is not a rounding error.
segments.tr: 对于家庭预算而言，这绝非小数目。

segments.src: It is the difference between an affordable monthly bill and a genuine financial strain.
segments.tr: 这是负担得起的月度账单与真正的经济压力之间的区别。

segments.src: The timing lines up with open enrollment season, which typically runs from November through mid-January in most states.
segments.tr: 这一时间点恰逢开放注册期，大多数州的开放注册期通常从 11 月持续到 1 月中旬。

segments.src: That means the sticker shock is landing right as households are being asked to actively choose or renew a plan for the coming year.
segments.tr: 这意味着，当家庭被要求主动选择或续订来年的计划时，他们正面临着这种价格冲击。

segments.src: ## Why the Cost of Coverage Is Rising
segments.tr: ## 保险成本为何上涨

segments.src: The core driver behind this increase is the scheduled expiration of enhanced federal subsidies that were first introduced during the pandemic and later extended.
segments.tr: 此次上涨背后的核心驱动因素是疫情期间首次推出并随后延期的增强型联邦补贴即将到期。

segments.src: Those enhanced tax credits reduced out-of-pocket premium costs for a broad range of income levels, including many middle-income households that previously received little or no assistance.
segments.tr: 这些增强型税收抵免降低了广泛收入水平人群的自付保费成本，包括许多以前几乎或完全没有获得援助的中等收入家庭。

segments.src: As those enhancements lapse, the subsidy amount shrinks, and the gap that enrollees must cover out of pocket grows — even if the sticker price of the underlying plan hasn't changed dramatically.
segments.tr: 随着这些增强措施失效，补贴金额缩水，参保人必须自付的差额随之增加——即使基础计划的标价并没有发生剧烈变化。

segments.src: On top of that, insurers in many states have also filed for higher base rates for next year, citing rising medical costs, hospital and prescription drug prices, and higher utilization of care.
segments.tr: 此外，许多州的保险公司也因医疗成本、医院和处方药价格上涨以及医疗服务利用率提高，申请了来年的更高基准费率。

segments.src: When a smaller subsidy meets a higher list price, the combined effect on what a family actually pays can be substantial.
segments.tr: 当较少的补贴遇上较高的标价，对家庭实际支付金额的综合影响可能是巨大的。

segments.src: ## Who Is Most Exposed
segments.tr: ## 谁受到的影响最大

segments.src: Health policy researchers estimate that as many as 4 million people could lose marketplace coverage in the coming year if enrollment trends continue on their current path.
segments.tr: 卫生政策研究人员估计，如果注册趋势按目前路径发展，未来一年可能有高达 400 万人失去市场保险。

segments.src: Early sign-up data already shows softening enrollment compared to the same point in prior years, which analysts attribute to affordability concerns and confusion around new subsidy amounts.
segments.tr: 早期注册数据显示，与往年同期相比，注册人数已经出现疲软，分析师将其归因于对负担能力的担忧以及对新补贴金额的困惑。

segments.src: The households most exposed tend to be:
segments.tr: 受影响最大的家庭通常是：

segments.src: - **Self-employed workers and small-business owners** who rely on the individual market because they don't have access to employer coverage.
segments.tr: - **自雇人士和小企业主**，他们依赖个人市场，因为他们无法获得雇主提供的保险。

segments.src: - **Early retirees** not yet eligible for Medicare who buy marketplace plans to bridge the gap.
segments.tr: - **提前退休人员**，尚未达到 Medicare 资格，他们购买市场计划以填补空窗期。

segments.src: - **Gig workers and freelancers** whose income can hover near the thresholds where subsidy eligibility changes sharply.
segments.tr: - **零工和自由职业者**，他们的收入可能徘徊在补贴资格发生剧烈变化的门槛附近。

segments.src: - **Middle-income families** who benefited from the temporary subsidy expansion but may fall outside more limited assistance going forward.
segments.tr: - **中等收入家庭**，他们曾受益于临时补贴扩张，但未来可能无法获得更有限的援助。

segments.src: ## What Experts Are Watching
segments.tr: ## 专家们在关注什么

segments.src: Nonpartisan researchers, insurance regulators, and consumer advocacy groups are watching two things closely this fall: whether Congress takes any action on subsidy levels before enrollment locks in for next year, and how state insurance marketplaces communicate the changes to enrollees.
segments.tr: 无党派研究人员、保险监管机构和消费者权益保护组织今年秋季正在密切关注两件事：国会在明年注册锁定前是否会对补贴水平采取任何行动，以及各州保险市场如何向参保人传达这些变化。

segments.src: Several state-run exchanges have said they are ramping up outreach and reminding consumers to actively shop around rather than letting a plan auto-renew, since switching to a different plan or metal tier can sometimes offset part of the increase.
segments.tr: 几个州运营的交易平台表示，他们正在加强外联工作，并提醒消费者主动货比三家，而不是让计划自动续订，因为切换到不同的计划或金属等级有时可以抵消部分涨幅。

segments.src: Consumer advocates also note that subsidy eligibility and amounts vary significantly by income, age, family size, and state, so national averages don't tell the whole story for any individual household.
segments.tr: 消费者权益倡导者还指出，补贴资格和金额因收入、年龄、家庭规模和州而异，因此全国平均水平并不能反映任何单个家庭的全部情况。

segments.src: A modest premium increase for one family could be a much larger jump for another, depending on exactly where their income falls relative to subsidy cutoffs.
segments.tr: 对于一个家庭来说适度的保费上涨，对另一个家庭来说可能是更大的跳升，具体取决于他们的收入相对于补贴截止点的确切位置。

segments.src: ## What Enrollees Can Do Right Now
segments.tr: ## 参保人现在可以做什么

segments.src: Financial counselors and healthcare navigators generally recommend a few concrete steps as open enrollment approaches:
segments.tr: 随着开放注册期的临近，财务顾问和医疗保健导航员通常建议采取以下具体步骤：

segments.src: 1. **Don't let your plan auto-renew without checking.** Log back into the marketplace and re-verify income and household information, since outdated estimates can affect your subsidy amount.
segments.tr: 1. **不要在不检查的情况下让您的计划自动续订。** 重新登录市场并重新核实收入和家庭信息，因为过时的估算可能会影响您的补贴金额。

segments.src: 2. **Compare plans across metal tiers.** A lower-premium bronze or silver plan with a higher deductible may make more financial sense for some households than staying on last year's plan.
segments.tr: 2. **比较不同金属等级的计划。** 对于某些家庭来说，保费较低但免赔额较高的铜级或银级计划，可能比维持去年的计划在财务上更合理。

segments.src: 3. **Ask about free local help.** Certified enrollment assisters and navigators, often available through community health centers or state marketplaces, can help estimate real costs at no charge.
segments.tr: 3. **询问免费的本地帮助。** 认证的注册协助员和导航员（通常可通过社区卫生中心或州市场获得）可以免费帮助估算实际成本。

segments.src: 4. **Check state-based programs.** Some states have supplemental subsidy programs on top of federal tax credits, which can meaningfully soften the increase.
segments.tr: 4. **检查州级项目。** 一些州在联邦税收抵免之外还有补充补贴计划，这可以显著缓解涨幅。

segments.src: ## The Bigger Picture
segments.tr: ## 更大的图景

segments.src: This year's premium jump is a reminder of how sensitive household healthcare costs are to federal policy decisions that can shift from one year to the next.
segments.tr: 今年的保费跳升提醒我们，家庭医疗保健成本对联邦政策决策有多么敏感，这些决策可能一年一变。

segments.src: Whether or not lawmakers revisit the subsidy structure, the immediate reality for many families is that the cost of maintaining coverage is going up, and open enrollment is the narrow window in which they can act to manage that increase.
segments.tr: 无论立法者是否重新审视补贴结构，许多家庭面临的直接现实是，维持保险的成本正在上升，而开放注册期是他们采取行动以应对这一增长的狭窄窗口。

segments.src: Financial advisors generally encourage anyone affected to review their options early rather than waiting until the final days of the enrollment period, when plan comparisons and assistance appointments become harder to schedule.
segments.tr: 财务顾问通常鼓励所有受影响的人尽早审查他们的选择，而不是等到注册期的最后几天，那时计划比较和预约协助将变得更难安排。

hi.title: 58% की वृद्धि और लगातार बढ़ोतरी: इस शरद ऋतु में लाखों लोगों को प्रभावित करने वाले ACA प्रीमियम शॉक के अंदर की बात

segments.src: ## A Sharp Jump in What Families Actually Pay
segments.tr: ## परिवारों द्वारा वास्तव में भुगतान की जाने वाली राशि में भारी उछाल

segments.src: Millions of Americans who buy health insurance through the Affordable Care Act marketplaces are opening their fall renewal notices to a jarring number.
segments.tr: लाखों अमेरिकी जो अफोर्डेबल केयर एक्ट (ACA) मार्केटप्लेस के माध्यम से स्वास्थ्य बीमा खरीदते हैं, वे अपने शरद ऋतु के नवीनीकरण नोटिस में एक चौंकाने वाली संख्या देख रहे हैं।

segments.src: According to research from health policy analysts, the average monthly premium that marketplace enrollees pay after tax credits are applied has climbed from about $113 to roughly $178 — an increase of nearly 58%.
segments.tr: स्वास्थ्य नीति विश्लेषकों के शोध के अनुसार, टैक्स क्रेडिट लागू होने के बाद मार्केटप्लेस के सदस्य जो औसत मासिक प्रीमियम चुकाते हैं, वह लगभग $113 से बढ़कर लगभग $178 हो गया है — जो लगभग 58% की वृद्धि है।

segments.src: For a household budget, that is not a rounding error.
segments.tr: एक घरेलू बजट के लिए, यह कोई मामूली अंतर नहीं है।

segments.src: It is the difference between an affordable monthly bill and a genuine financial strain.
segments.tr: यह एक किफायती मासिक बिल और वास्तविक वित्तीय दबाव के बीच का अंतर है।

segments.src: The timing lines up with open enrollment season, which typically runs from November through mid-January in most states.
segments.tr: इसका समय ओपन एनरोलमेंट सीजन के साथ मेल खाता है, जो आमतौर पर अधिकांश राज्यों में नवंबर से मध्य जनवरी तक चलता है।

segments.src: That means the sticker shock is landing right as households are being asked to actively choose or renew a plan for the coming year.
segments.tr: इसका मतलब है कि यह कीमत का झटका ठीक उसी समय लग रहा है जब परिवारों से आने वाले वर्ष के लिए सक्रिय रूप से एक योजना चुनने या नवीनीकृत करने के लिए कहा जा रहा है।

segments.src: ## Why the Cost of Coverage Is Rising
segments.tr: ## कवरेज की लागत क्यों बढ़ रही है

segments.src: The core driver behind this increase is the scheduled expiration of enhanced federal subsidies that were first introduced during the pandemic and later extended.
segments.tr: इस वृद्धि के पीछे मुख्य कारण उन उन्नत संघीय सब्सिडी की निर्धारित समाप्ति है जिन्हें पहली बार महामारी के दौरान पेश किया गया था और बाद में बढ़ाया गया था।

segments.src: Those enhanced tax credits reduced out-of-pocket premium costs for a broad range of income levels, including many middle-income households that previously received little or no assistance.
segments.tr: उन उन्नत टैक्स क्रेडिट ने आय के व्यापक स्तरों के लिए जेब से होने वाले प्रीमियम खर्चों को कम कर दिया था, जिसमें कई मध्यम-आय वाले परिवार भी शामिल थे जिन्हें पहले बहुत कम या कोई सहायता नहीं मिलती थी।

segments.src: As those enhancements lapse, the subsidy amount shrinks, and the gap that enrollees must cover out of pocket grows — even if the sticker price of the underlying plan hasn't changed dramatically.
segments.tr: जैसे-जैसे वे सुधार समाप्त हो रहे हैं, सब्सिडी की राशि कम हो रही है, और वह अंतर जिसे सदस्यों को अपनी जेब से भरना पड़ता है, बढ़ रहा है — भले ही मूल योजना की कीमत में नाटकीय रूप से बदलाव न आया हो।

segments.src: On top of that, insurers in many states have also filed for higher base rates for next year, citing rising medical costs, hospital and prescription drug prices, and higher utilization of care.
segments.tr: इसके अलावा, कई राज्यों में बीमाकर्ताओं ने अगले वर्ष के लिए उच्च आधार दरों के लिए भी आवेदन किया है, जिसका कारण बढ़ती चिकित्सा लागत, अस्पताल और प्रिस्क्रिप्शन दवाओं की कीमतें, और देखभाल का अधिक उपयोग बताया गया है।

segments.src: When a smaller subsidy meets a higher list price, the combined effect on what a family actually pays can be substantial.
segments.tr: जब एक छोटी सब्सिडी एक उच्च सूची मूल्य से मिलती है, तो परिवार जो वास्तव में भुगतान करता है उस पर संयुक्त प्रभाव काफी हो सकता है।

segments.src: ## Who Is Most Exposed
segments.tr: ## सबसे अधिक प्रभावित कौन है

segments.src: Health policy researchers estimate that as many as 4 million people could lose marketplace coverage in the coming year if enrollment trends continue on their current path.
segments.tr: स्वास्थ्य नीति शोधकर्ताओं का अनुमान है कि यदि नामांकन के रुझान अपने वर्तमान रास्ते पर चलते रहे तो आने वाले वर्ष में 4 मिलियन तक लोग मार्केटप्लेस कवरेज खो सकते हैं।

segments.src: Early sign-up data already shows softening enrollment compared to the same point in prior years, which analysts attribute to affordability concerns and confusion around new subsidy amounts.
segments.tr: प्रारंभिक साइन-अप डेटा पहले ही पिछले वर्षों की समान अवधि की तुलना में नामांकन में कमी दिखा रहा है, जिसे विश्लेषक सामर्थ्य संबंधी चिंताओं और नई सब्सिडी राशि के बारे में भ्रम का कारण मानते हैं।

segments.src: The households most exposed tend to be:
segments.tr: सबसे अधिक प्रभावित होने वाले परिवार आमतौर पर ये हैं:

segments.src: - **Self-employed workers and small-business owners** who rely on the individual market because they don't have access to employer coverage.
segments.tr: - **स्व-रोजगार वाले श्रमिक और छोटे व्यवसाय के मालिक** जो व्यक्तिगत बाजार पर निर्भर हैं क्योंकि उनके पास नियोक्ता कवरेज तक पहुंच नहीं है।

segments.src: - **Early retirees** not yet eligible for Medicare who buy marketplace plans to bridge the gap.
segments.tr: - **प्रारंभिक सेवानिवृत्त लोग** जो अभी तक मेडिकेयर के लिए पात्र नहीं हैं और अंतर को पाटने के लिए मार्केटप्लेस योजनाएं खरीदते हैं।

segments.src: - **Gig workers and freelancers** whose income can hover near the thresholds where subsidy eligibility changes sharply.
segments.tr: - **गिग वर्कर और फ्रीलांसर** जिनकी आय उन सीमाओं के आसपास हो सकती है जहां सब्सिडी पात्रता तेजी से बदलती है।

segments.src: - **Middle-income families** who benefited from the temporary subsidy expansion but may fall outside more limited assistance going forward.
segments.tr: - **मध्यम-आय वाले परिवार** जिन्हें अस्थायी सब्सिडी विस्तार से लाभ हुआ था, लेकिन वे भविष्य में अधिक सीमित सहायता के दायरे से बाहर हो सकते हैं।

segments.src: ## What Experts Are Watching
segments.tr: ## विशेषज्ञ क्या देख रहे हैं

segments.src: Nonpartisan researchers, insurance regulators, and consumer advocacy groups are watching two things closely this fall: whether Congress takes any action on subsidy levels before enrollment locks in for next year, and how state insurance marketplaces communicate the changes to enrollees.
segments.tr: गैर-पक्षपाती शोधकर्ता, बीमा नियामक और उपभोक्ता वकालत समूह इस शरद ऋतु में दो चीजों पर बारीकी से नजर रख रहे हैं: क्या कांग्रेस अगले वर्ष के लिए नामांकन लॉक होने से पहले सब्सिडी स्तरों पर कोई कार्रवाई करती है, और राज्य बीमा मार्केटप्लेस सदस्यों को परिवर्तनों के बारे में कैसे सूचित करते हैं।

segments.src: Several state-run exchanges have said they are ramping up outreach and reminding consumers to actively shop around rather than letting a plan auto-renew, since switching to a different plan or metal tier can sometimes offset part of the increase.
segments.tr: कई राज्य-संचालित एक्सचेंजों ने कहा है कि वे आउटरीच बढ़ा रहे हैं और उपभोक्ताओं को याद दिला रहे हैं कि वे किसी योजना को ऑटो-नवीनीकृत होने देने के बजाय सक्रिय रूप से खरीदारी करें, क्योंकि किसी अलग योजना या मेटल टियर पर स्विच करने से कभी-कभी वृद्धि का कुछ हिस्सा कम हो सकता है।

segments.src: Consumer advocates also note that subsidy eligibility and amounts vary significantly by income, age, family size, and state, so national averages don't tell the whole story for any individual household.
segments.tr: उपभोक्ता अधिवक्ताओं का यह भी कहना है कि सब्सिडी पात्रता और राशि आय, आयु, परिवार के आकार और राज्य के अनुसार काफी भिन्न होती है, इसलिए राष्ट्रीय औसत किसी भी व्यक्तिगत परिवार के लिए पूरी कहानी नहीं बताते हैं।

segments.src: A modest premium increase for one family could be a much larger jump for another, depending on exactly where their income falls relative to subsidy cutoffs.
segments.tr: एक परिवार के लिए मामूली प्रीमियम वृद्धि दूसरे के लिए बहुत बड़ी छलांग हो सकती है, जो इस बात पर निर्भर करता है कि उनकी आय सब्सिडी कटऑफ के सापेक्ष कहां आती है।

segments.src: ## What Enrollees Can Do Right Now
segments.tr: ## सदस्य अभी क्या कर सकते हैं

segments.src: Financial counselors and healthcare navigators generally recommend a few concrete steps as open enrollment approaches:
segments.tr: वित्तीय सलाहकार और स्वास्थ्य सेवा नेविगेटर आमतौर पर ओपन एनरोलमेंट के करीब आने पर कुछ ठोस कदम उठाने की सलाह देते हैं:

segments.src: 1. **Don't let your plan auto-renew without checking.** Log back into the marketplace and re-verify income and household information, since outdated estimates can affect your subsidy amount.
segments.tr: 1. **जांच किए बिना अपनी योजना को ऑटो-नवीनीकृत न होने दें।** मार्केटप्लेस में वापस लॉग इन करें और आय और घरेलू जानकारी को फिर से सत्यापित करें, क्योंकि पुरानी जानकारी आपकी सब्सिडी राशि को प्रभावित कर सकती है।

segments.src: 2. **Compare plans across metal tiers.** A lower-premium bronze or silver plan with a higher deductible may make more financial sense for some households than staying on last year's plan.
segments.tr: 2. **मेटल टियर में योजनाओं की तुलना करें।** कुछ परिवारों के लिए पिछले साल की योजना पर बने रहने की तुलना में उच्च डिडक्टिबल वाली कम-प्रीमियम वाली ब्रोंज या सिल्वर योजना अधिक वित्तीय समझदारी भरा निर्णय हो सकती है।

segments.src: 3. **Ask about free local help.** Certified enrollment assisters and navigators, often available through community health centers or state marketplaces, can help estimate real costs at no charge.
segments.tr: 3. **मुफ्त स्थानीय मदद के बारे में पूछें।** प्रमाणित नामांकन सहायक और नेविगेटर, जो अक्सर सामुदायिक स्वास्थ्य केंद्रों या राज्य मार्केटप्लेस के माध्यम से उपलब्ध होते हैं, बिना किसी शुल्क के वास्तविक लागत का अनुमान लगाने में मदद कर सकते हैं।

segments.src: 4. **Check state-based programs.** Some states have supplemental subsidy programs on top of federal tax credits, which can meaningfully soften the increase.
segments.tr: 4. **राज्य-आधारित कार्यक्रमों की जांच करें।** कुछ राज्यों में संघीय टैक्स क्रेडिट के अलावा पूरक सब्सिडी कार्यक्रम हैं, जो वृद्धि को काफी हद तक कम कर सकते हैं।

segments.src: ## The Bigger Picture
segments.tr: ## बड़ी तस्वीर

segments.src: This year's premium jump is a reminder of how sensitive household healthcare costs are to federal policy decisions that can shift from one year to the next.
segments.tr: इस वर्ष की प्रीमियम वृद्धि इस बात की याद दिलाती है कि घरेलू स्वास्थ्य सेवा लागत संघीय नीतिगत निर्णयों के प्रति कितनी संवेदनशील है जो एक वर्ष से दूसरे वर्ष में बदल सकते हैं।

segments.src: Whether or not lawmakers revisit the subsidy structure, the immediate reality for many families is that the cost of maintaining coverage is going up, and open enrollment is the narrow window in which they can act to manage that increase.
segments.tr: चाहे कानून निर्माता सब्सिडी संरचना पर पुनर्विचार करें या नहीं, कई परिवारों के लिए तत्काल वास्तविकता यह है कि कवरेज बनाए रखने की लागत बढ़ रही है, और ओपन एनरोलमेंट वह सीमित समय है जिसमें वे उस वृद्धि को प्रबंधित करने के लिए कार्य कर सकते हैं।

segments.src: Financial advisors generally encourage anyone affected to review their options early rather than waiting until the final days of the enrollment period, when plan comparisons and assistance appointments become harder to schedule.
segments.tr: वित्तीय सलाहकार आमतौर पर प्रभावित किसी भी व्यक्ति को नामांकन अवधि के अंतिम दिनों तक प्रतीक्षा करने के बजाय जल्दी से अपने विकल्पों की समीक्षा करने के लिए प्रोत्साहित करते हैं, जब योजना की तुलना और सहायता नियुक्तियों को निर्धारित करना कठिन हो जाता है।

segments.tr: El momento coincide con la temporada de inscripción abierta, que generalmente se extiende de noviembre a mediados de enero en la mayoría de los estados.

segments.src: That means the sticker shock is landing right as households are being asked to actively choose or renew a plan for the coming year.
segments.tr: Eso significa que el impacto por el precio se produce justo cuando se pide a los hogares que elijan o renueven activamente un plan para el próximo año.

segments.src: ## Why the Cost of Coverage Is Rising
segments.tr: ## Por qué está aumentando el costo de la cobertura

segments.src: The core driver behind this increase is the scheduled expiration of enhanced federal subsidies that were first introduced during the pandemic and later extended.
segments.tr: El factor principal detrás de este aumento es la expiración programada de los subsidios federales mejorados que se introdujeron por primera vez durante la pandemia y luego se extendieron.

segments.src: Those enhanced tax credits reduced out-of-pocket premium costs for a broad range of income levels, including many middle-income households that previously received little or no assistance.
segments.tr: Esos créditos fiscales mejorados redujeron los costos de bolsillo de las primas para una amplia gama de niveles de ingresos, incluidos muchos hogares de ingresos medios que anteriormente recibían poca o ninguna asistencia.

segments.src: As those enhancements lapse, the subsidy amount shrinks, and the gap that enrollees must cover out of pocket grows — even if the sticker price of the underlying plan hasn't changed dramatically.
segments.tr: A medida que esas mejoras caducan, el monto del subsidio se reduce y la brecha que los inscritos deben cubrir de su bolsillo crece, incluso si el precio de lista del plan subyacente no ha cambiado drásticamente.

segments.src: On top of that, insurers in many states have also filed for higher base rates for next year, citing rising medical costs, hospital and prescription drug prices, and higher utilization of care.
segments.tr: Además de eso, las aseguradoras en muchos estados también han solicitado tasas base más altas para el próximo año, citando el aumento de los costos médicos, los precios de los hospitales y los medicamentos recetados, y una mayor utilización de la atención.

segments.src: When a smaller subsidy meets a higher list price, the combined effect on what a family actually pays can be substantial.
segments.tr: Cuando un subsidio menor se encuentra con un precio de lista más alto, el efecto combinado en lo que realmente paga una familia puede ser sustancial.

segments.src: ## Who Is Most Exposed
segments.tr: ## Quiénes son los más expuestos

segments.src: Health policy researchers estimate that as many as 4 million people could lose marketplace coverage in the coming year if enrollment trends continue on their current path.
segments.tr: Los investigadores de políticas de salud estiman que hasta 4 millones de personas podrían perder la cobertura del mercado en el próximo año si las tendencias de inscripción continúan en su trayectoria actual.

segments.src: Early sign-up data already shows softening enrollment compared to the same point in prior years, which analysts attribute to affordability concerns and confusion around new subsidy amounts.
segments.tr: Los datos iniciales de inscripción ya muestran una disminución en comparación con el mismo punto en años anteriores, lo que los analistas atribuyen a preocupaciones sobre la asequibilidad y la confusión en torno a los nuevos montos de los subsidios.

segments.src: The households most exposed tend to be:
segments.tr: Los hogares más expuestos tienden a ser:

segments.src: - **Self-employed workers and small-business owners** who rely on the individual market because they don't have access to employer coverage.
segments.tr: - **Trabajadores autónomos y propietarios de pequeñas empresas** que dependen del mercado individual porque no tienen acceso a cobertura por parte del empleador.

segments.src: - **Early retirees** not yet eligible for Medicare who buy marketplace plans to bridge the gap.
segments.tr: - **Jubilados anticipados** que aún no son elegibles para Medicare y que compran planes del mercado para cerrar la brecha.

segments.src: - **Gig workers and freelancers** whose income can hover near the thresholds where subsidy eligibility changes sharply.
segments.tr: - **Trabajadores de la economía colaborativa (gig workers) y trabajadores independientes** cuyos ingresos pueden fluctuar cerca de los umbrales donde la elegibilidad para subsidios cambia drásticamente.

segments.src: - **Middle-income families** who benefited from the temporary subsidy expansion but may fall outside more limited assistance going forward.
segments.tr: - **Familias de ingresos medios** que se beneficiaron de la expansión temporal de los subsidios pero que pueden quedar fuera de una asistencia más limitada en el futuro.

segments.src: ## What Experts Are Watching
segments.tr: ## Qué están observando los expertos

segments.src: Nonpartisan researchers, insurance regulators, and consumer advocacy groups are watching two things closely this fall: whether Congress takes any action on subsidy levels before enrollment locks in for next year, and how state insurance marketplaces communicate the changes to enrollees.
segments.tr: Los investigadores no partidistas, los reguladores de seguros y los grupos de defensa del consumidor están observando de cerca dos cosas este otoño: si el Congreso toma alguna medida sobre los niveles de subsidio antes de que se cierre la inscripción para el próximo año, y cómo los mercados de seguros estatales comunican los cambios a los inscritos.

segments.src: Several state-run exchanges have said they are ramping up outreach and reminding consumers to actively shop around rather than letting a plan auto-renew, since switching to a different plan or metal tier can sometimes offset part of the increase.
segments.tr: Varios intercambios administrados por el estado han dicho que están intensificando la divulgación y recordando a los consumidores que busquen activamente en lugar de dejar que un plan se renueve automáticamente, ya que cambiar a un plan diferente o a un nivel de metal distinto a veces puede compensar parte del aumento.

segments.src: Consumer advocates also note that subsidy eligibility and amounts vary significantly by income, age, family size, and state, so national averages don't tell the whole story for any individual household.
segments.tr: Los defensores del consumidor también señalan que la elegibilidad y los montos de los subsidios varían significativamente según los ingresos, la edad, el tamaño de la familia y el estado, por lo que los promedios nacionales no cuentan toda la historia para ningún hogar individual.

segments.src: A modest premium increase for one family could be a much larger jump for another, depending on exactly where their income falls relative to subsidy cutoffs.
segments.tr: Un aumento modesto de la prima para una familia podría ser un salto mucho mayor para otra, dependiendo exactamente de dónde caigan sus ingresos en relación con los límites de los subsidios.

segments.src: ## What Enrollees Can Do Right Now
segments.tr: ## Qué pueden hacer los inscritos ahora mismo

segments.src: Financial counselors and healthcare navigators generally recommend a few concrete steps as open enrollment approaches:
segments.tr: Los asesores financieros y los navegadores de atención médica generalmente recomiendan algunos pasos concretos a medida que se acerca la inscripción abierta:

segments.src: 1. **Don't let your plan auto-renew without checking.** Log back into the marketplace and re-verify income and household information, since outdated estimates can affect your subsidy amount.
segments.tr: 1. **No deje que su plan se renueve automáticamente sin verificar.** Vuelva a iniciar sesión en el mercado y vuelva a verificar los ingresos y la información del hogar, ya que las estimaciones obsoletas pueden afectar el monto de su subsidio.

segments.src: 2. **Compare plans across metal tiers.** A lower-premium bronze or silver plan with a higher deductible may make more financial sense for some households than staying on last year's plan.
segments.tr: 2. **Compare planes entre niveles de metal.** Un plan bronce o plata con una prima más baja y un deducible más alto puede tener más sentido financiero para algunos hogares que quedarse con el plan del año pasado.

segments.src: 3. **Ask about free local help.** Certified enrollment assisters and navigators, often available through community health centers or state marketplaces, can help estimate real costs at no charge.
segments.tr: 3. **Pregunte sobre ayuda local gratuita.** Los asistentes de inscripción certificados y los navegadores, a menudo disponibles a través de centros de salud comunitarios o mercados estatales, pueden ayudar a estimar los costos reales sin cargo.

segments.src: 4. **Check state-based programs.** Some states have supplemental subsidy programs on top of federal tax credits, which can meaningfully soften the increase.
segments.tr: 4. **Consulte los programas estatales.** Algunos estados tienen programas de subsidios suplementarios además de los créditos fiscales federales, que pueden suavizar significativamente el aumento.

segments.src: ## The Bigger Picture
segments.tr: ## El panorama general

segments.src: This year's premium jump is a reminder of how sensitive household healthcare costs are to federal policy decisions that can shift from one year to the next.
segments.tr: El salto en las primas de este año es un recordatorio de cuán sensibles son los costos de atención médica de los hogares a las decisiones de política federal que pueden cambiar de un año a otro.

segments.src: Whether or not lawmakers revisit the subsidy structure, the immediate reality for many families is that the cost of maintaining coverage is going up, and open enrollment is the narrow window in which they can act to manage that increase.
segments.tr: Independientemente de si los legisladores revisan o no la estructura de subsidios, la realidad inmediata para muchas familias es que el costo de mantener la cobertura está aumentando, y la inscripción abierta es la ventana estrecha en la que pueden actuar para gestionar ese aumento.

segments.src: Financial advisors generally encourage anyone affected to review their options early rather than waiting until the final days of the enrollment period, when plan comparisons and assistance appointments become harder to schedule.
segments.tr: Los asesores financieros generalmente alientan a cualquier persona afectada a revisar sus opciones con anticipación en lugar de esperar hasta los últimos días del período de inscripción, cuando las comparaciones de planes y las citas de asistencia se vuelven más difíciles de programar.

segments.src: According to research from health policy analysts, the average monthly premium that marketplace enrollees pay after tax credits are applied has climbed from about $113 to roughly $178 — an increase of nearly 58%.
segments.tr: وفقاً لبحث أجراه محللو السياسات الصحية، فإن متوسط القسط الشهرى الذي دفعه المسجلون في السوق بعد تطبيق الإئتمانات الضريبية قد ارتفع من نحو $113 إلى حوالي $178 — وهي زيادة تتجاوز 58%.

segments.src: For a household budget, that is not a rounding error.
segments.tr: بالنسبة لميزانية الأسرة، هذا ليس خطأ تقريب حسابي.

segments.src: It is the difference between an affordable monthly bill and a genuine financial strain.
segments.tr: بل إنه الفارق بين فاتورة شهرية ميسورة التكلفة وإجهاد مالي حقيقي.

segments.src: The timing lines up with open enrollment season, which typically runs from November through mid-January in most states.
segments.tr: ويتزامن هذا التوقيت مع موسم التسجيل المفتوح، الذي يمتد عادةً من نوفمبر حتى منتصف يناير في معظم الولايات.

segments.src: That means the sticker shock is landing right as households are being asked to actively choose or renew a plan for the coming year.
segments.tr: وهذا يعني أن صدمة الأسعار تحدث في الوقت الذي يُطلب فيه من الأسر اختيار خطة أو تجديدها بنشاط للعام القادم.

segments.src: ## Why the Cost of Coverage Is Rising
segments.tr: ## لماذا ترتفع تكلفة تغطية التأمين

segments.src: The core driver behind this increase is the scheduled expiration of enhanced federal subsidies that were first introduced during the pandemic and later extended.
segments.tr: الدوافع الأساسية وراء هذه الزيادة هي الانتهاء المقرر للدعم الفيدرالي المعزز الذي تم تقديمه لأول مرة خلال الجائحة وتمديده لاحقاً.

segments.src: Those enhanced tax credits reduced out-of-pocket premium costs for a broad range of income levels, including many middle-income households that previously received little or no assistance.
segments.tr: أدت تلك الإئتمانات الضريبية المعززة إلى تقليل التكاليف المباشرة للأقساط لمجموعة واسعة من مستويات الدخل، بما في ذلك العديد من الأسر متوسطة الدخل التي كانت تتلقى مساعدة ضئيلة أو لا تتلقاها على الإطلاق سابقاً.

segments.src: As those enhancements lapse, the subsidy amount shrinks, and the gap that enrollees must cover out of pocket grows — even if the sticker price of the underlying plan hasn't changed dramatically.
segments.tr: ومع انقضاء هذه التحسينات، يتضاءل مبلغ الدعم، وتتسع الفجوة التي يجب على المسجلين تغطيتها من جيوبهم الخاص — حتى لو لم يتغير السعر المعلن للخطة الأساسية بشكل كبير.

segments.src: On top of that, insurers in many states have also filed for higher base rates for next year, citing rising medical costs, hospital and prescription drug prices, and higher utilization of care.
segments.tr: علاوة على ذلك، تقدمت شركات التأمين في العديد من الولايات أيضاً بطلب للحصول على أسعار أساسية أعلى للعام المقبل، معللة ذلك بارتفاع التكاليف الطبية، وأسعار المستشفيات والأدوية الموصوفة، وزيادة الاستفادة من الرعاية الصحية.

segments.src: When a smaller subsidy meets a higher list price, the combined effect on what a family actually pays can be substantial.
segments.tr: وعندما يلتقي دعم أصغر بسعر معلن أعلى، يمكن أن يكون الأثر المجمع على ما تدفعه الأسرة فعلياً كبيراً جداً.

segments.tr: ## من هم الأكثر عرضة للتأثر

segments.src: ## Why the Cost of Coverage Is Rising
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi le coût de la couverture augmente

segments.src: The core driver behind this increase is the scheduled expiration of enhanced federal subsidies that were first introduced during the pandemic and later extended.
segments.tr: Le principal moteur de cette hausse est l'expiration prévue des subventions fédérales renforcées, introduites pour la première fois pendant la pandémie et prolongées par la suite.

segments.src: Those enhanced tax credits reduced out-of-pocket premium costs for a broad range of income levels, including many middle-income households that previously received little or no assistance.
segments.tr: Ces crédits d'impôt bonifiés réduisaient les coûts des primes à la charge des assurés pour un large éventail de niveaux de revenus, y compris de nombreux ménages à revenus moyens qui ne recevaient auparavant que peu ou pas d'aide.

segments.src: As those enhancements lapse, the subsidy amount shrinks, and the gap that enrollees must cover out of pocket grows — even if the sticker price of the underlying plan hasn't changed dramatically.
segments.tr: Avec la fin de ces bonifications, le montant de la subvention diminue et l'écart que les assurés doivent couvrir de leur poche s'accroît, même si le prix affiché du plan de base n'a pas changé de manière spectaculaire.

segments.src: On top of that, insurers in many states have also filed for higher base rates for next year, citing rising medical costs, hospital and prescription drug prices, and higher utilization of care.
segments.tr: De plus, les assureurs de nombreux États ont également demandé des tarifs de base plus élevés pour l'année prochaine, invoquant la hausse des coûts médicaux, des prix des hôpitaux et des médicaments sur ordonnance, ainsi qu'une utilisation accrue des soins.

segments.src: When a smaller subsidy meets a higher list price, the combined effect on what a family actually pays can be substantial.
segments.tr: Lorsqu'une subvention plus faible rencontre un prix catalogue plus élevé, l'effet combiné sur ce qu'une famille paie réellement peut être substantiel.

segments.src: ## Who Is Most Exposed
segments.tr: ## Qui est le plus exposé

segments.src: Health policy researchers estimate that as many as 4 million people could lose marketplace coverage in the coming year if enrollment trends continue on their current path.
segments.tr: Les chercheurs en politiques de santé estiment que jusqu'à 4 millions de personnes pourraient perdre leur couverture du marché au cours de l'année à venir si les tendances d'inscription se poursuivent sur leur lancée actuelle.

segments.src: Early sign-up data already shows softening enrollment compared to the same point in prior years, which analysts attribute to affordability concerns and confusion around new subsidy amounts.
segments.tr: Les premières données d'inscription montrent déjà un ralentissement par rapport à la même période des années précédentes, ce que les analystes attribuent aux inquiétudes concernant l'accessibilité financière et à la confusion autour des nouveaux montants des subventions.

segments.src: The households most exposed tend to be:
segments.tr: Les ménages les plus exposés ont tendance à être :

segments.src: - **Self-employed workers and small-business owners** who rely on the individual market because they don't have access to employer coverage.
segments.tr: - **Les travailleurs indépendants et les propriétaires de petites entreprises** qui dépendent du marché individuel parce qu'ils n'ont pas accès à une couverture d'employeur.

segments.src: - **Early retirees** not yet eligible for Medicare who buy marketplace plans to bridge the gap.
segments.tr: - **Les préretraités** qui ne sont pas encore éligibles à Medicare et qui achètent des plans du marché pour faire la transition.

segments.src: - **Gig workers and freelancers** whose income can hover near the thresholds where subsidy eligibility changes sharply.
segments.tr: - **Les travailleurs de la gig economy et les freelances** dont les revenus peuvent osciller près des seuils où l'éligibilité aux subventions change radicalement.

segments.src: - **Middle-income families** who benefited from the temporary subsidy expansion but may fall outside more limited assistance going forward.
segments.tr: - **Les familles à revenus moyens** qui ont bénéficié de l'extension temporaire des subventions mais qui risquent de se retrouver exclues d'une aide plus limitée à l'avenir.

segments.src: ## What Experts Are Watching
segments.tr: ## Ce que les experts surveillent

segments.src: Nonpartisan researchers, insurance regulators, and consumer advocacy groups are watching two things closely this fall: whether Congress takes any action on subsidy levels before enrollment locks in for next year, and how state insurance marketplaces communicate the changes to enrollees.
segments.tr: Les chercheurs non partisans, les régulateurs d'assurance et les groupes de défense des consommateurs surveillent de près deux éléments cet automne : si le Congrès prendra des mesures concernant le niveau des subventions avant que les inscriptions ne soient verrouillées pour l'année prochaine, et comment les marchés d'assurance des États communiquent ces changements aux assurés.

segments.src: Several state-run exchanges have said they are ramping up outreach and reminding consumers to actively shop around rather than letting a plan auto-renew, since switching to a different plan or metal tier can sometimes offset part of the increase.
segments.tr: Plusieurs plateformes gérées par les États ont déclaré qu'elles intensifiaient leurs efforts de sensibilisation et rappelaient aux consommateurs de comparer activement les offres plutôt que de laisser un plan se renouveler automatiquement, car passer à un autre plan ou à une autre catégorie de couverture peut parfois compenser une partie de la hausse.

segments.src: Consumer advocates also note that subsidy eligibility and amounts vary significantly by income, age, family size, and state, so national averages don't tell the whole story for any individual household.
segments.tr: Les défenseurs des consommateurs soulignent également que l'éligibilité et le montant des subventions varient considérablement selon le revenu, l'âge, la taille de la famille et l'État, de sorte que les moyennes nationales ne reflètent pas la situation réelle de chaque ménage.

segments.src: A modest premium increase for one family could be a much larger jump for another, depending on exactly where their income falls relative to subsidy cutoffs.
segments.tr: Une augmentation modérée de la prime pour une famille pourrait représenter un bond beaucoup plus important pour une autre, selon la situation exacte de leurs revenus par rapport aux seuils de subvention.

segments.src: ## What Enrollees Can Do Right Now
segments.tr: ## Ce que les assurés peuvent faire dès maintenant

segments.src: Financial counselors and healthcare navigators generally recommend a few concrete steps as open enrollment approaches:
segments.tr: Les conseillers financiers et les guides de santé recommandent généralement quelques étapes concrètes à l'approche de la période d'inscription ouverte :

segments.src: 1. **Don't let your plan auto-renew without checking.** Log back into the marketplace and re-verify income and household information, since outdated estimates can affect your subsidy amount.
segments.tr: 1. **Ne laissez pas votre plan se renouveler automatiquement sans vérification.** Reconnectez-vous au marché et vérifiez à nouveau vos revenus et les informations relatives à votre ménage, car des estimations obsolètes peuvent affecter le montant de votre subvention.

segments.src: 2. **Compare plans across metal tiers.** A lower-premium bronze or silver plan with a higher deductible may make more financial sense for some households than staying on last year's plan.
segments.tr: 2. **Comparez les plans entre les différentes catégories de couverture.** Un plan bronze ou silver à prime inférieure avec une franchise plus élevée peut être plus judicieux financièrement pour certains ménages que de conserver le plan de l'année dernière.

segments.src: 3. **Ask about free local help.** Certified enrollment assisters and navigators, often available through community health centers or state marketplaces, can help estimate real costs at no charge.
segments.tr: 3. **Renseignez-vous sur l'aide locale gratuite.** Des conseillers et guides d'inscription certifiés, souvent disponibles via des centres de santé communautaires ou les marchés des États, peuvent vous aider à estimer les coûts réels gratuitement.

segments.src: 4. **Check state-based programs.** Some states have supplemental subsidy programs on top of federal tax credits, which can meaningfully soften the increase.
segments.tr: 4. **Vérifiez les programmes basés sur l'État.** Certains États proposent des programmes de subventions supplémentaires en plus des crédits d'impôt fédéraux, ce qui peut atténuer de manière significative la hausse.

segments.src: ## The Bigger Picture
segments.tr: ## Une vue d'ensemble

segments.src: This year's premium jump is a reminder of how sensitive household healthcare costs are to federal policy decisions that can shift from one year to the next.
segments.tr: Le bond des primes de cette année rappelle à quel point les coûts de santé des ménages sont sensibles aux décisions politiques fédérales, qui peuvent changer d'une année sur l'autre.

segments.src: Whether or not lawmakers revisit the subsidy structure, the immediate reality for many families is that the cost of maintaining coverage is going up, and open enrollment is the narrow window in which they can act to manage that increase.
segments.tr: Que les législateurs revoient ou non la structure des subventions, la réalité immédiate pour de nombreuses familles est que le coût du maintien de la couverture augmente, et la période d'inscription ouverte est la seule fenêtre d'opportunité dont elles disposent pour agir afin de gérer cette hausse.

segments.src: Financial advisors generally encourage anyone affected to review their options early rather than waiting until the final days of the enrollment period, when plan comparisons and assistance appointments become harder to schedule.
segments.tr: Les conseillers financiers encouragent généralement toutes les personnes concernées à examiner leurs options tôt plutôt que d'attendre les derniers jours de la période d'inscription, moment où les comparaisons de plans et les rendez-vous d'assistance deviennent plus difficiles à planifier.

pt.title: 58% Mais Alto e Subindo: Por Dentro do Choque de Prêmios do ACA que Afeta Milhões de Pessoas Neste Outono

segments.src: ## A Sharp Jump in What Families Actually Pay
segments.tr: ## Um Salto Abrupto no que as Famílias Realmente Pagam

segments.src: Millions of Americans who buy health insurance through the Affordable Care Act marketplaces are opening their fall renewal notices to a jarring number.
segments.tr: Milhões de americanos que compram seguro de saúde por meio dos mercados do Affordable Care Act estão abrindo seus avisos de renovação de outono com um número alarmante.

segments.src: According to research from health policy analysts, the average monthly premium that marketplace enrollees pay after tax credits are applied has climbed from about $113 to roughly $178 — an increase of nearly 58%.
segments.tr: De acordo com pesquisas de analistas de políticas de saúde, o prêmio mensal médio que os inscritos no mercado pagam após a aplicação dos créditos fiscais subiu de cerca de $113 para aproximadamente $178 — um aumento de quase 58%.

segments.src: For a household budget, that is not a rounding error.
segments.tr: Para o orçamento de um lar, isso não é um erro de arredondamento.

segments.src: It is the difference between an affordable monthly bill and a genuine financial strain.
segments.tr: É a diferença entre uma conta mensal acessível e uma verdadeira sobrecarga financeira.

segments.src: The timing lines up with open enrollment season, which typically runs from November through mid-January in most states.
segments.tr: O momento coincide com a temporada de inscrições abertas, que normalmente vai de novembro a meados de janeiro na maioria dos estados.

segments.src: That means the sticker shock is landing right as households are being asked to actively choose or renew a plan for the coming year.
segments.tr: Isso significa que o choque do preço está chegando exatamente no momento em que os lares estão sendo solicitados a escolher ou renovar ativamente um plano para o próximo ano.

segments.src: ## Why the Cost of Coverage Is Rising
segments.tr: ## Por Que o Custo da Cobertura Está Subindo

segments.src: The core driver behind this increase is the scheduled expiration of enhanced federal subsidies that were first introduced during the pandemic and later extended.
segments.tr: O principal fator por trás desse aumento é a expiração programada dos subsídios federais ampliados que foram introduzidos pela primeira vez durante a pandemia e posteriormente prorrogados.

segments.src: Those enhanced tax credits reduced out-of-pocket premium costs for a broad range of income levels, including many middle-income households that previously received little or no assistance.
segments.tr: Esses créditos fiscais ampliados reduziram os custos de prêmios do próprio bolso para uma ampla gama de faixas de renda, incluindo muitos lares de classe média que anteriormente recebiam pouca ou nenhuma assistência.

segments.src: As those enhancements lapse, the subsidy amount shrinks, and the gap that enrollees must cover out of pocket grows — even if the sticker price of the underlying plan hasn't changed dramatically.
segments.tr: Com o fim dessas ampliações, o valor do subsídio diminui e a diferença que os inscritos devem cobrir do próprio bolso aumenta — mesmo que o preço de tabela do plano subjacente não tenha mudado drasticamente.

segments.src: On top of that, insurers in many states have also filed for higher base rates for next year, citing rising medical costs, hospital and prescription drug prices, and higher utilization of care.
segments.tr: Além disso, as seguradoras em muitos estados também solicitaram tarifas básicas mais altas para o próximo ano, citando o aumento dos custos médicos, dos preços de hospitais e medicamentos prescritos, e uma maior utilização de cuidados de saúde.

segments.src: When a smaller subsidy meets a higher list price, the combined effect on what a family actually pays can be substantial.
segments.tr: Quando um subsídio menor se depara com um preço de tabela mais alto, o efeito combinado sobre o que uma família realmente paga pode ser substancial.

segments.src: ## Who Is Most Exposed
segments.tr: ## Quem Está Mais Exposto

segments.tr: Pesquisadores de políticas de saúde estimam que até 4 milhões de pessoas podem perder a cobertura do mercado no próximo ano se as tendências de inscrição continuarem em seu caminho atual.

segments.src: Early sign-up data already shows softening enrollment compared to the same point in prior years, which analysts attribute to affordability concerns and confusion around new subsidy amounts.
segments.tr: Os dados iniciais de inscrição já mostram uma desaceleração em comparação com o mesmo período de anos anteriores, o que os analistas atribuem a preocupações com a acessibilidade financeira e à confusão em torno dos novos valores de subsídio.

segments.src: The households most exposed tend to be:
segments.tr: Os lares mais expostos tendem a ser:

segments.src: - **Self-employed workers and small-business owners** who rely on the individual market because they don't have access to employer coverage.
segments.tr: - **Trabalhadores autônomos e proprietários de pequenas empresas** que dependem do mercado individual porque não têm acesso à cobertura do empregador.

segments.src: - **Early retirees** not yet eligible for Medicare who buy marketplace plans to bridge the gap.
segments.tr: - **Aposentados precoces** que ainda não são elegíveis para o Medicare e que compram planos do mercado para cobrir esse período de transição.

segments.src: - **Gig workers and freelancers** whose income can hover near the thresholds where subsidy eligibility changes sharply.
segments.tr: - **Trabalhadores de gig economy e freelancers** cuja renda pode oscilar perto dos limites onde a elegibilidade para o subsídio muda drasticamente.

segments.src: - **Middle-income families** who benefited from the temporary subsidy expansion but may fall outside more limited assistance going forward.
segments.tr: - **Famílias de classe média** que se beneficiaram da expansão temporária dos subsídios, mas que podem ficar de fora de uma assistência mais limitada daqui para frente.

segments.src: ## What Experts Are Watching
segments.tr: ## O Que os Especialistas Estão Observando

segments.src: Nonpartisan researchers, insurance regulators, and consumer advocacy groups are watching two things closely this fall: whether Congress takes any action on subsidy levels before enrollment locks in for next year, and how state insurance marketplaces communicate the changes to enrollees.
segments.tr: Pesquisadores apartidários, reguladores de seguros e grupos de defesa do consumidor estão observando duas coisas de perto neste outono: se o Congresso tomará alguma medida sobre os níveis de subsídio antes que as inscrições se encerrem para o próximo ano, e como os mercados de seguros estaduais comunicam as mudanças aos inscritos.

segments.src: Several state-run exchanges have said they are ramping up outreach and reminding consumers to actively shop around rather than letting a plan auto-renew, since switching to a different plan or metal tier can sometimes offset part of the increase.

segments.tr: Os defensores do consumidor também observam que a elegibilidade e os valores dos subsídios variam significativamente de acordo com a renda, idade, tamanho da família e estado, de modo que as médias nacionais não contam a história completa de cada lar individual.

segments.src: A modest premium increase for one family could be a much larger jump for another, depending on exactly where their income falls relative to subsidy cutoffs.
segments.tr: Um aumento modesto no prêmio para uma família pode ser um salto muito maior para outra, dependendo exatamente de onde sua renda se enquadra em relação aos limites de corte dos subsídios.

segments.src: ## What Enrollees Can Do Right Now
segments.tr: ## O Que os Inscritos Podem Fazer Agora Mesmo

segments.src: Financial counselors and healthcare navigators generally recommend a few concrete steps as open enrollment approaches:
segments.tr: Conselheiros financeiros e orientadores de saúde geralmente recomendam alguns passos concretos à medida que o período de inscrições abertas se aproxima:

segments.src: 1. **Don't let your plan auto-renew without checking.** Log back into the marketplace and re-verify income and household information, since outdated estimates can affect your subsidy amount.
segments.tr: 1. **Não deixe seu plano renovar automaticamente sem verificar.** Acesse o mercado novamente e verifique as informações de renda e do grupo familiar, pois estimativas desatualizadas podem afetar o valor do seu subsídio.

segments.src: 2. **Compare plans across metal tiers.** A lower-premium bronze or silver plan with a higher deductible may make more financial sense for some households than staying on last year's plan.
segments.tr: 2. **Compare planos entre as categorias de metal.** Um plano bronze ou prata com prêmio mais baixo e franquia mais alta pode fazer mais sentido financeiro para alguns lares do que continuar no plano do ano passado.

segments.src: 3. **Ask about free local help.** Certified enrollment assisters and navigators, often available through community health centers or state marketplaces, can help estimate real costs at no charge.
segments.tr: 3. **Pergunte sobre ajuda local gratuita.** Assistentes e orientadores de inscrição certificados, frequentemente disponíveis em centros de saúde comunitários ou mercados estaduais, podem ajudar a estimar os custos reais sem custo algum.

segments.src: 4. **Check state-based programs.** Some states have supplemental subsidy programs on top of federal tax credits, which can meaningfully soften the increase.
segments.tr: 4. **Verifique os programas estaduais.** Alguns estados possuem programas de subsídios suplementares além dos créditos fiscais federais, o que pode suavizar significativamente o aumento.

segments.src: ## The Bigger Picture
segments.tr: ## O Cenário Geral

segments.tr: O salto nos prêmios deste ano é um lembrete de quão sensíveis são os custos de saúde das famílias às decisões de políticas federais que podem mudar de um ano para o outro.

segments.tr: Rumah tangga yang paling terdampak cenderung adalah:

segments.src: ## What Experts Are Watching
segments.tr: ## Apa yang Dipantau Para Ahli

segments.src: Nonpartisan researchers, insurance regulators, and consumer advocacy groups are watching two things closely this fall: whether Congress takes any action on subsidy levels before enrollment locks in for next year, and how state insurance marketplaces communicate the changes to enrollees.
segments.tr: Para peneliti nonpartisan, regulator asuransi, dan kelompok advokasi konsumen mengamati dua hal dengan cermat musim gugur ini: apakah Kongres mengambil tindakan apa pun terkait tingkat subsidi sebelum pendaftaran dikunci untuk tahun depan, dan bagaimana pasar asuransi negara bagian mengomunikasikan perubahan tersebut kepada peserta.

segments.src: Several state-run exchanges have said they are ramping up outreach and reminding consumers to actively shop around rather than letting a plan auto-renew, since switching to a different plan or metal tier can sometimes offset part of the increase.
segments.tr: Beberapa bursa yang dikelola negara bagian mengatakan mereka meningkatkan penjangkauan dan mengingatkan konsumen untuk secara aktif berbelanja alih-alih membiarkan paket diperbarui secara otomatis, karena beralih ke paket atau tingkat logam yang berbeda terkadang dapat mengimbangi sebagian dari kenaikan tersebut.

segments.src: Consumer advocates also note that subsidy eligibility and amounts vary significantly by income, age, family size, and state, so national averages don't tell the whole story for any individual household.
segments.tr: Advokat konsumen juga mencatat bahwa kelayakan dan jumlah subsidi sangat bervariasi berdasarkan pendapatan, usia, ukuran keluarga, dan negara bagian, sehingga rata-rata nasional tidak menceritakan keseluruhan cerita untuk setiap rumah tangga individu.

segments.src: A modest premium increase for one family could be a much larger jump for another, depending on exactly where their income falls relative to subsidy cutoffs.
segments.tr: Kenaikan premi yang moderat bagi satu keluarga bisa menjadi lonjakan yang jauh lebih besar bagi keluarga lain, tergantung pada di mana tepatnya pendapatan mereka jatuh relatif terhadap batas subsidi.

segments.src: ## What Enrollees Can Do Right Now
segments.tr: ## Apa yang Dapat Dilakukan Peserta Saat Ini

segments.src: Financial counselors and healthcare navigators generally recommend a few concrete steps as open enrollment approaches:
segments.tr: Konselor keuangan dan navigator layanan kesehatan umumnya merekomendasikan beberapa langkah konkret menjelang pendaftaran terbuka:

segments.src: 1. **Don't let your plan auto-renew without checking.** Log back into the marketplace and re-verify income and household information, since outdated estimates can affect your subsidy amount.
segments.tr: 1. **Jangan biarkan paket Anda diperbarui secara otomatis tanpa memeriksa.** Masuk kembali ke pasar dan verifikasi ulang pendapatan serta informasi rumah tangga, karena perkiraan yang kedaluwarsa dapat memengaruhi jumlah subsidi Anda.

segments.src: 2. **Compare plans across metal tiers.** A lower-premium bronze or silver plan with a higher deductible may make more financial sense for some households than staying on last year's plan.
segments.tr: 2. **Bandingkan paket di seluruh tingkat logam.** Paket perunggu atau perak dengan premi lebih rendah dan pengurangan (deductible) lebih tinggi mungkin lebih masuk akal secara finansial bagi beberapa rumah tangga daripada tetap menggunakan paket tahun lalu.

segments.src: 3. **Ask about free local help.** Certified enrollment assisters and navigators, often available through community health centers or state marketplaces, can help estimate real costs at no charge.
segments.tr: 3. **Tanyakan tentang bantuan lokal gratis.** Asisten pendaftaran dan navigator bersertifikat, yang sering tersedia melalui pusat kesehatan masyarakat atau pasar negara bagian, dapat membantu memperkirakan biaya sebenarnya tanpa biaya.

segments.src: 4. **Check state-based programs.** Some states have supplemental subsidy programs on top of federal tax credits, which can meaningfully soften the increase.
segments.tr: 4. **Periksa program berbasis negara bagian.** Beberapa negara bagian memiliki program subsidi tambahan di atas kredit pajak federal, yang dapat secara signifikan meringankan kenaikan tersebut.

segments.src: ## The Bigger Picture
segments.tr: ## Gambaran yang Lebih Besar

segments.src: This year's premium jump is a reminder of how sensitive household healthcare costs are to federal policy decisions that can shift from one year to the next.
segments.tr: Lonjakan premi tahun ini adalah pengingat betapa sensitifnya biaya perawatan kesehatan rumah tangga terhadap keputusan kebijakan federal yang dapat berubah dari satu tahun ke tahun berikutnya.

segments.src: Whether or not lawmakers revisit the subsidy structure, the immediate reality for many families is that the cost of maintaining coverage is going up, and open enrollment is the narrow window in which they can act to manage that increase.
segments.tr: Terlepas dari apakah pembuat undang-undang meninjau kembali struktur subsidi atau tidak, kenyataan langsung bagi banyak keluarga adalah bahwa biaya untuk mempertahankan pertanggungan meningkat, dan pendaftaran terbuka adalah jendela sempit di mana mereka dapat bertindak untuk mengelola kenaikan tersebut.

segments.src: Financial advisors generally encourage anyone affected to review their options early rather than waiting until the final days of the enrollment period, when plan comparisons and assistance appointments become harder to schedule.
segments.tr: Penasihat keuangan umumnya mendorong siapa pun yang terdampak untuk meninjau opsi mereka lebih awal daripada menunggu hingga hari-hari terakhir periode pendaftaran, ketika perbandingan paket dan janji temu bantuan menjadi lebih sulit untuk dijadwalkan.

ja.title: 58%の上昇とその先へ：今秋、何百万人もの人々を襲うACA保険料ショックの実態

segments.src: ## A Sharp Jump in What Families Actually Pay
segments.tr: ## 実際に支払う金額の急激な跳ね上がり

segments.src: Millions of Americans who buy health insurance through the Affordable Care Act marketplaces are opening their fall renewal notices to a jarring number.
segments.tr: 医療保険制度改革（ACA）のマーケットプレイスを通じて健康保険に加入している何百万人ものアメリカ人が、秋の更新通知を開いてショックを受けています。

segments.src: According to research from health policy analysts, the average monthly premium that marketplace enrollees pay after tax credits are applied has climbed from about $113 to roughly $178 — an increase of nearly 58%.
segments.tr: 医療政策アナリストの調査によると、マーケットプレイスの加入者が税額控除適用後に支払う平均月額保険料は約113ドルから約178ドルへと、約58%も上昇しました。

segments.src: For a household budget, that is not a rounding error.
segments.tr: 家計にとって、それは無視できるほどの誤差ではありません。

segments.src: It is the difference between an affordable monthly bill and a genuine financial strain.
segments.tr: 手頃な月々の請求書と、本当の経済的負担との違いなのです。

segments.src: The timing lines up with open enrollment season, which typically runs from November through mid-January in most states.
segments.tr: このタイミングは、通常ほとんどの州で11月から1月中旬にかけて行われるオープン・エンロールメント（加入申込期間）と重なっています。

segments.src: That means the sticker shock is landing right as households are being asked to actively choose or renew a plan for the coming year.
segments.tr: つまり、家計が来年のプランを積極的に選択または更新するよう求められているまさにその時に、この値上がりのショックが直撃しているのです。

segments.src: ## Why the Cost of Coverage Is Rising
segments.tr: ## 保険料が高騰している理由

segments.src: The core driver behind this increase is the scheduled expiration of enhanced federal subsidies that were first introduced during the pandemic and later extended.
segments.tr: この値上がりの主な原因は、パンデミック時に導入されその後延長された、拡充された連邦補助金の期限切れが予定通り訪れたことです。

segments.src: Those enhanced tax credits reduced out-of-pocket premium costs for a broad range of income levels, including many middle-income households that previously received little or no assistance.
segments.tr: それらの拡充された税額控除は、これまで支援をほとんどあるいは全く受けられなかった多くの中所得世帯を含む、幅広い所得層の自己負担による保険料コストを削減していました。

segments.src: As those enhancements lapse, the subsidy amount shrinks, and the gap that enrollees must cover out of pocket grows — even if the sticker price of the underlying plan hasn't changed dramatically.
segments.tr: それらの拡充措置が失効するにつれて補助金の額が縮小し、加入者が自己負担しなければならない差額が膨らんでいきます。たとえ、基礎となるプランの定価が劇的に変わっていなくてもです。

segments.src: On top of that, insurers in many states have also filed for higher base rates for next year, citing rising medical costs, hospital and prescription drug prices, and higher utilization of care.
segments.tr: それに加え、多くの州の保険会社は、医療費の上昇、病院や処方薬の価格高騰、医療利用の増加を理由に、来年の基本料金の値上げを申請しています。

segments.src: When a smaller subsidy meets a higher list price, the combined effect on what a family actually pays can be substantial.
segments.tr: より少額の補助金とより高い定価が出会うとき、家族が実際に支払う金額への複合的な影響は相当なものになり得ます。

segments.src: ## Who Is Most Exposed
segments.tr: ## 最も影響を受けるのは誰か

segments.src: Health policy researchers estimate that as many as 4 million people could lose marketplace coverage in the coming year if enrollment trends continue on their current path.
segments.tr: 医療政策の研究者らは、現在の加入動向が続けば、来年には最大400万人がマーケットプレイスの保障を失う可能性があると推計しています。

segments.src: Early sign-up data already shows softening enrollment compared to the same point in prior years, which analysts attribute to affordability concerns and confusion around new subsidy amounts.
segments.tr: 初期のサインアップデータによれば、前年の同じ時期と比較して加入の鈍化がすでに見られており、アナリストはこれを手頃さに対する懸念や新しい補助金額に関する混乱に起因するものとしています。

segments.src: The households most exposed tend to be:
segments.tr: 最も影響を受ける傾向にある世帯は以下の通りです：

segments.src: - **Self-employed workers and small-business owners** who rely on the individual market because they don't have access to employer coverage.
segments.tr: - **自営業者および中小企業の経営者**：勤務先の保険に加入できないため、個人向け市場に頼らざるを得ない人々。

segments.src: - **Early retirees** not yet eligible for Medicare who buy marketplace plans to bridge the gap.
segments.tr: - **早期退職者**：まだメディケアの受給資格がなく、その間のギャップを埋めるためにマーケットプレイスのプランを購入している人々。

segments.src: - **Gig workers and freelancers** whose income can hover near the thresholds where subsidy eligibility changes sharply.
segments.tr: - **ギグワーカーおよびフリーランス**：補助金の受給資格が急激に変わるしきい値の付近を収入が行き来する人々。

segments.src: - **Middle-income families** who benefited from the temporary subsidy expansion but may fall outside more limited assistance going forward.
segments.tr: - **中所得世帯**：一時的な補助金拡大の恩恵を受けたものの、今後はより限定的な支援の対象外となる可能性がある人々。

segments.src: ## What Experts Are Watching
segments.tr: ## 専門家が注目していること

segments.src: Nonpartisan researchers, insurance regulators, and consumer advocacy groups are watching two things closely this fall: whether Congress takes any action on subsidy levels before enrollment locks in for next year, and how state insurance marketplaces communicate the changes to enrollees.
segments.tr: 超党派の研究者、保険規制当局、および消費者擁護団体は、この秋、次の2つのことに注目しています。それは、来年の加入が確定する前に議会が補助金の水準に関して何らかの行動を起こすかどうか、そして各州の保険マーケットプレイスが加入者にどのように変更を伝えるかという点です。

segments.src: Several state-run exchanges have said they are ramping up outreach and reminding consumers to actively shop around rather than letting a plan auto-renew, since switching to a different plan or metal tier can sometimes offset part of the increase.
segments.tr: いくつかの州営取引所は、自動更新に任せるのではなく、積極的に比較検討するよう消費者に注意を促し、アウトリーチを強化していると述べています。別のプランやメダル階層に切り替えることで、値上がりの一部を相殺できる場合があるためです。

segments.src: Consumer advocates also note that subsidy eligibility and amounts vary significantly by income, age, family size, and state, so national averages don't tell the whole story for any individual household.
segments.tr: また、消費者擁護団体は、補助金の受給資格や金額が所得、年齢、家族構成、州によって大きく異なるため、全国平均は個々の世帯の全体像を語るものではないと指摘しています。

segments.src: A modest premium increase for one family could be a much larger jump for another, depending on exactly where their income falls relative to subsidy cutoffs.
segments.tr: ある家族にとってはわずかな保険料の値上げであっても、補助金の打ち切りラインに対して所得がどこに位置するかによっては、別の家族にとってははるかに大きな跳ね上がりとなる可能性があります。

segments.src: ## What Enrollees Can Do Right Now
segments.tr: ## 加入者が今すぐできること

segments.src: Financial counselors and healthcare navigators generally recommend a few concrete steps as open enrollment approaches:
segments.tr: ファイナンシャル・カウンセラーや医療費ナビゲーターは、加入受付期間が近づくにつれて、いくつかの具体的なステップを踏むことを一般的に推奨しています：

segments.src: 1. **Don't let your plan auto-renew without checking.** Log back into the marketplace and re-verify income and household information, since outdated estimates can affect your subsidy amount.
segments.tr: 1. **確認せずにプランを自動更新させない。** 古い見積もりは補助金の額に影響を与える可能性があるため、マーケットプレイスに再度ログインし、所得や世帯情報を再確認しましょう。

segments.src: 2. **Compare plans across metal tiers.** A lower-premium bronze or silver plan with a higher deductible may make more financial sense for some households than staying on last year's plan.
segments.tr: 2. **メダル階層を横断してプランを比較する。** 免責金額が高い保険料の安いブロンズやシルバーのプランは、昨年のプランに留まるよりも、一部の世帯にとって経済的により理にかなっている場合があります。

segments.src: 3. **Ask about free local help.** Certified enrollment assisters and navigators, often available through community health centers or state marketplaces, can help estimate real costs at no charge.
segments.tr: 3. **無料の地元サポートについて問い合わせる。** コミュニティヘルスセンターや州のマーケットプレイスなどを通じて利用できる認定された加入支援者やナビゲーターは、実際の費用を無料で試算する手助けをしてくれます。

segments.src: 4. **Check state-based programs.** Some states have supplemental subsidy programs on top of federal tax credits, which can meaningfully soften the increase.
segments.tr: 4. **州独自のプログラムを確認する。** 一部の州には、連邦の税額控除に上乗せする形で、値上がりを意味合い的に和らげることができる追加の補助金プログラムがあります。

segments.src: ## The Bigger Picture
segments.tr: ## より大きな視点

segments.src: This year's premium jump is a reminder of how sensitive household healthcare costs are to federal policy decisions that can shift from one year to the next.
segments.tr: 今年の保険料の跳ね上がりは、家庭の医療費が、年から年へと変化しうる連邦の政策決定いかに敏感であるかを思い知らせるものです。

segments.src: Whether or not lawmakers revisit the subsidy structure, the immediate reality for many families is that the cost of maintaining coverage is going up, and open enrollment is the narrow window in which they can act to manage that increase.
segments.tr: 議員が補助金の構造を見直すかどうかにかかわらず、多くの家族にとって直近の現実とは、保障を維持するためのコストが上昇しているということであり、オープン・エンロールメントはその値上がりに対処するために行動を起こせる限られた期間なのです。

segments.src: Financial advisors generally encourage anyone affected to review their options early rather than waiting until the final days of the enrollment period, when plan comparisons and assistance appointments become harder to schedule.
segments.tr: ファイナンシャル・アドバイザーは、影響を受けるすべての人に対し、プランの比較や支援の予約が取りにくくなる加入期間の最終日まで待つのではなく、早い段階で自分の選択肢を確認することを一般的に勧めています。
